newsitem.title: POLAND: TRAINS CRASH IN POLAND'S KUNOWICE, ONE WOUNDED.
newsitem.headline: TRAINS CRASH IN POLAND'S KUNOWICE, ONE WOUNDED.

text.p: A passenger train from Moscow to Berlin on Thursday hit the back of a freight train standing at the station in the town of Kunowice on the Polish-German border, wounding one person, a Polish railway spokeswoman said.

Alicja Bialobrzeska of the Polish State Railways (PKP) press office told Reuters that as a result of the collision the passenger train locomotive caught fire, two cars of the freight train were destroyed and one passenger car was damaged.
"At four o'clock in the morning the passenger train from Msocow to Berlin hit the back of a freight train standing in Kunowice. One person was wounded and taken to hospital," Bialobrzeska said.
She said regular train traffic in Kunowice had been resumed an hour after the accident but had not comment on its causes.
